morphology.formula: ∅ + Vitaly → Vitaly（外来人名，整词记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 以下按男性人名 Vitaly 解释，规范书写须大写首字母。它不适用马来语词缀分析；尚无可确认的马来语标准音标、分音节或爪夷文拼写。

senses.zh_definition: 维塔利：男性人名，常用于转写俄语名字 Виталий。此解释仅适用于人名，不能据此认定 vitaly 是马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: A masculine given name, commonly a romanization of Russian Виталий.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki yang lazimnya merupakan ejaan Rumi bagi nama Rusia Виталий.
senses.nuances: 输入资料没有提供可核实的 DBP 释义，因此不能标为 official。以下搭配与情景均按人名编写；搭配是自然的称呼及组合示例，不代表经语料统计确认的高频搭配。原文若指品牌或其他专名，须按上下文另行判断。人名及其读音参见 [Russian Given Names: Their Pronunciation, Meaning, and Frequency](https://ans-names.pitt.edu/ans/article/download/1729/1728/3460)。

etymology.historical_story: Vitaly belongs to a European naming tradition rather than a Malay derivational family. The Russian masculine name Виталий appears in Roman letters as Vitaly or Vitaliy. Its ancestry is connected with Latin vita, meaning life, and the name Vitalis. Several early saints bore the name, linking its history with Christian naming traditions. Its historical meaning does not function as a Malay common-word definition. [Source: Russian Given Names](https://ans-names.pitt.edu/ans/article/download/1729/1728/3460).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Vitaly 与英语 vitality（活力）联想起来，记住“充满生命力的维塔利”；这是人名记忆联想，不是马来语释义或构词分析。
